items.title: How Klaviyo processes 3 billion daily events at scale with Amazon MSK Express
items.summary: Learn how Klaviyo migrated its event pipeline from RabbitMQ to Amazon MSK Express brokers, ingesting roughly 3 billion events per day. A small team scaled the broker fleet multi-fold for Black Friday/Cyber Monday 2025, delivered 22.7 billion messages (up 25% year over year), then scaled back down.
items.creator: Jonathan Li
categories: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
